messages:
Alex Wu: Heads-up — noticed a ~6% drop in tenant X's invoice-preview after the sampling rollout yesterday. dashboard preview vs. ledger diverging.
Samira Patel: I saw similar for a couple tenants, thought it was a late-ingest lag. Any shard hot spots?
Ben Ortiz: quick check: ingest-shard-3 was on the old sampler for ~37m during the rollout, others moved to deterministic hashing. likely cause.
Maria Gomez: Oof. That explains cohort mismatches. Our dashboard scaler assumes a uniform sample_rate per run, not per-shard.
Alex Wu: Repro steps: replayed 10k events for tenant X, sampling headers varied between shards -> aggregate multiplier wrong. can share logs.
Samira Patel: Can we attach the sample_cohort/id to events so aggregator can upscale correctly? Right now only a boolean sampled=true + sample_rate header that isn't consistent.
Ben Ortiz: Proposal: add X-Sample-Seed (hex) + X-Sample-Rate in ingress. Deterministic assignment: cohort = hash(tenant_id, seed) % N. Aggregator upscales by cohort-aware weight.
Maria Gomez: UX ask: Console should surface "effective sample_rate" per tenant and per-interval so product sees why preview != ledger. Also show if canary rolled back.
Alex Wu: Agreed. Also need migration plan: backfill older events have no seed. Aggregator fallback: if no seed -> use cluster-global sample_rate and mark as legacy.
Samira Patel: Implementation detail: small patch in edge-proxy to set header. Example:
```
# edge-proxy snippet
headers['X-Sample-Seed'] = hex(seed)
headers['X-Sample-Rate'] = str(sample_rate)
```
Ben Ortiz: And aggregator SQL upscaling tweak:
```
SELECT cohort, count(*) * (1.0 / sample_rate) as estimated_tokens
FROM events
GROUP BY cohort
```
But use cohort when seed present.
Maria Gomez: Dash changes: add a sampling badge on invoice preview card, tooltip explains cohort scaling + link to sampling audit. Also flag in timeline when shard mismatch detected.
Alex Wu: Rollout plan: 1) add header in canary edge (1 shard), 2) aggregator reads cohort if present and marks preview, 3) expose in console as opt-in flag, 4) flip default after 48h.
Samira Patel: Alerting: add monitor for preview_vs_ledger_delta > 2% for > 15m post-rollout. Also a high-cardinality log sample for tenants hit.
Ben Ortiz: Ops note: we must ensure sample_seed is stable across restarts for sticky cohorts; seed changes == cohort reshuffle -> big deltas. persist seed in config service.
Maria Gomez: Can we include a quick mitigation in case of discrepancy: console shows a "Use legacy scaling" toggle to force previous behavior while we roll fixes?
Alex Wu: Yeah keep toggle. If we see >5% regression enable toggle and rollback ingest canary.
Samira Patel: I've filed a small RFC and put the edge patch PR up: PR#4523. will add aggregator change + console card in follow-ups.
ingest-bot: canary deployed to ingest-shard-3 with X-Sample-Seed=0x7b4a, sample_rate=0.1 at 1769912500
dash-bot: alert: invoice_preview_delta for tenant X = 6.2% over last 30m (triggered at 1769912600)
Alex Wu: Thanks — keeping this thread as the rollup. I'll ping infra for seed persistence and ops for monitor runbooks.
